verdict.rationale: Deel's own marketing says it runs payroll for employees, contractors and EOR workers from one platform, with 'real-time cost visibility', which loosely touches previewing totals. Nothing documents the actual run flow: reviewing hours and earnings, a pre-submit preview, or a submit step in one flow. missing for 10: documented payroll-run workflow, hours/earnings review step, totals preview before submission, submit/approve step, any hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow

citations.quote: Run accurate, compliant payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers across 150+ countries with unified data, automated compliance, and real-time cost visibility.
Pay every worker type, in every country, from one platform.
